name: Milena Janković
bio:
Milena Janković's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for complex machines, fueled by her father's work as a mechanic. She pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, excelling in thermodynamics and fluid dynamics. After graduating, Milena joined a small touring car team, quickly rising through the ranks due to her meticulous data analysis and problem-solving skills. Her career took her to various racing disciplines, including GT racing and Formula 3, where she honed her ability to extract maximum performance from both the car and the drivers she worked with.

Milena is known for her demanding yet fair approach. She believes in pushing boundaries and constantly seeking improvements, but always with a focus on teamwork and open communication. Her ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights for the driver, combined with her strategic race management skills, makes her a highly sought-after race engineer. Milena’s unwavering dedication and exceptional management skills have made her a valuable asset to any team she joins.

physical.description: Milena is of average height and athletic build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Insists on a specific blend of herbal tea before each race.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
